why: Deploy both Goblin Tokens as blockers—each token blocks one attacker. Token #0 blocks Grizzly Bears (2/2), Token #1 blocks Rumbling Baloth (4/4). Both tokens will die to combat damage, but each blocker absorbs the attacking damage (preventing it from reaching my face). This mitigates all incoming damage: Grizzly Bears and Rumbling Baloth each deal their combat damage to the blockers instead of me, leaving me at 5 life heading into my turn 14. With my remaining Bonebreaker Giant and fresh threats, I maintain lethal potential on my final turn.
